pr.status.title: Read GitHub status
pr.status.summary: Ask GitHub for status and apply the declared thread policy.

pr.merge.title: Merge the expected head
pr.merge.summary: Squash merge a ready PR with the head pinned, then read it back.

pr.threads.title: List review threads
pr.threads.summary: List review threads with ids, author, location and a fenced text excerpt; optionally only unresolved ones.

pr.reply.title: Reply to a review comment
pr.reply.summary: Post a reply on a review thread through GitHub.

pr.resolve.title: Resolve a review thread
pr.resolve.summary: Resolve a thread on GitHub, then read it back and report whether it is resolved.
